cc:Work.dc:title: HYPER S3 ROCKET functional block diagram

svg.title: HYPER S3 ROCKET functional block diagram
svg.desc: The microcontroller sits in the centre with its pin tabs inset evenly from its edges. Red arrows show power connections and white arrows with a black outline show signal connections. USB-C and the solar input sit in line with the User I/O blocks along the top. The User I/O group holds the external I2C bus, UART, GPIO 3 to 14 and SMD pads 39 to 42 and 47. An optional group along the bottom holds the magnetometer, IMU with accelerometer and gyroscope, altimeter, a dashed microSD card and the back red LED. On the left are the solar input, charger, 3.3 V 2 A regulator, guard, eFuse, polarity guard, a dashed battery that is not included, and battery sensing. On the right are the LEDs, BOOT and RESET buttons and the RTC.
svg.text: HYPER S3 ROCKET - Functional Block Diagram
Touch / ADC / PWM / I2S / TWAI ( CAN 2.0B )
Isolated World Controller / HMAC & Digital Signature (DS)
Dual-core 32-bit Xtensa LX7 up to 240 MHz
